imageGeneration.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / detail restoration. Asset: high-resolution photographic environment texture for an existing Three.js winter scene. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET and geometry/framing reference. Produce the exact same winter night photograph composition at 3840x2160 or nearest high resolution with identical aspect ratio. This is a detail restoration, not a new composition. Preserve the horizon at y=.50, the mountain silhouettes, exact tree trunks/branches, open sky and all forest placement. Preserve the small stone/log ember bed centered x=.6105 y=.681 in the ORIGINAL image, same footprint and perspective, but resolve the stones, split charred wood, tiny glowing coals, cracked ash and rough granular surfaces with sharp photographic detail. No tall flames; flames are added separately as video. Preserve the existing tiny orange ember light pool; DO NOT bake green/violet aurora lighting into this texture because dynamic lighting is separate. Improve the ground with crisp natural snow crystal granules, wind-scoured ripples and subtle irregular packed snow texture, coherent perspective: small fine detail far away, visible crunchy grains in foreground. Resolve pine needles, bark fissures, snow-loaded twigs and naturally irregular fluffy snowy branch edges. Deep blue night illumination unchanged, no bright daylight. Preserve empty clear night sky and star field (no aurora in the image), same foreground and empty center. Do not add footprints, paths, people, snowmen, boxes, ice cubes, keys, text or UI. Preserve proportions and camera; no zoom, no pan, no reframing. No painterly smoothing, no halo sharpening, no artificial uniformly repeated noise. The goal is a premium fine-detail photorealistic restoration of THIS exact image.
